name: Haizono Shouhei
source: A multitalented delinquent with diverse interests who can pick up any new skill with ease. His cocky attitude tends to rub people the wrong way. He and Leo have been partners in crime since before they came to Darkwick. A capable cook, he is particular about his dishes.
